query: SELECT pz.id, pz.purpose, pz.label, pz.posX, pz.posY, pz.width, pz.height FROM product_zones pz JOIN product_parts pp ON pz.partId = pp.id WHERE pp.productId = 1380006 AND pp.`key` = 'front' ORDER BY pz.id;
